thread:
Maya Singh: Quick follow-up from the yesterday's PM — recurring latency spikes on gen-serve during autoscale. I want action owners, estimated timelines, and a simple RACI so we don't lose ownership. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Sachin Patel: I can take ownership of the remediation work on caching/queueing. Will spin up a Jira and a short plan.
Lia Gomez: I'll own the KV cache instrumentation + alert tuning. Can pair with Sachin on load test runs.
Maya Singh: Thanks. Can we get tickets and a 2-week target for the first mitigation (prefix caching + alerting)? We should also capture the recurring pattern in the incident tracker. :spiral_calendar:
Sachin Patel: Creating Jira now — INF-8791: gen-serve cache thrash mitigation (will include tests, metrics, rollout plan). Target: 2 weeks.
Sachin Patel: Plan sketch: 1) prefix-level caching enabled (opt-in) 2) throttle strategy during scale 3) validation e2e perf tests 4) canary rollout.
Emily Chen: I'll be product-contacted for customer impact comms and acceptance criteria. Emily -> add acceptance tests that verify tail-latency < 250ms under scale.
Jordan Park: I'll handle the canary pipeline for Dedicated and add automatic rollback on error rates.
Lia Gomez: RACI draft: R: Sachin (implementation), A: Maya (pm signoff), C: Lia (metrics/alerts) and Jordan (canary/infra), I: Emily (product/customer). Thoughts?
Maya Singh: Looks good. Add timeboxed handoff checkpoints: 3-day plan update, 1-week demo, 2-week rollout. Post updates into this thread and attach Jira links.
ops-bot: New Jira created by Sachin: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-8791 (INF-8791)
Sachin Patel: Also creating INF-8792 for follow-up work: general routing policy & fallback variants to reduce cross-region fallout.
Emily Chen: Can we include a small eval suite that detects regression in output quality when fallback kicks in? Add to INF-8792 please.
Sachin Patel: Yep — adding an eval checklist.
Lia Gomez: Quick note on pattern: these spikes correlate with autoscale events + cache cold-starts after scale. Recommend we add a metric for "KV hit-rate after scale" and an alert when it drops > 30% for >1m.
Jordan Park: Agreed. I'll wire that metric into Console dashboards and add it to the postmortem recurring-incident tracker.
Maya Singh: Owner assignments final: Sachin (INF-8791 + INF-8792), Lia (alerts/metrics), Jordan (canary), Emily (acceptance/comms). Please add names to Jira assignees and tag with "pm-followup" label.
Sachin Patel: Done. Assigned tickets to the group and set initial due date + two-week target.
Maya Singh: Small handoff rule: if owner unavailable for >3 business days, hand to the rotation lead (Jordan). I'll add to the ticket template.
Emily Chen: Adding acceptance checklist now in INF-8791.
Lia Gomez: I'll run a short load test tomorrow to validate the prefix-caching hypothesis and post a short log snippet here.
Maya Singh: Great. After the 2-week rollout we'll revisit recurrence: if the pattern persists we'll escalate to a dedicated remediation sprint. For now, tackle quick wins. :white_check_mark:
Jordan Park: Noted. Will schedule the canary for next Wed in Dedicated.
Maya Singh: Thanks everyone. Keep updates here and ping me @Maya if you need priority unblock. :eyes:
